query: SELECT h.device_id, a.node_id, a.direct_addrs FROM device_library_holding h JOIN device d ON d.org_id = h.org_id AND d.id = h.device_id JOIN device_node_addr a ON a.org_id = h.org_id AND a.device_id = h.device_id WHERE h.org_id = $1 AND h.hash = $2 AND h.device_id <> $3 AND d.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.last_seen_at >= $4 ORDER BY d.last_seen_at DESC
